title: Letter on Sullivan's death sent to the FBI but never received

tellings.quote: And we I took we took that information. We've composed a letter, sent it to the FBI uh through the oversight committee only to later we we we had been told that it had been sent later we found out that it had never been received.

plain: Eric Burlison, a US congressman, says that he and his team took information about the death of a man named Sullivan, linked to the UFO whistleblower David Grusch, and wrote a letter about it to the FBI through the House Oversight Committee, the part of Congress that investigates the government. He says they were told the letter had been sent, but later found out the FBI never got it. He tells it to suggest that inquiries on this subject get quietly blocked.
